metaDescription: Order custom short sleeve pants and shorts for your team. Perfect for uniforms, events, and giveaways. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Short sleeve pants and shorts combine the comfort of a relaxed fit with the practicality of a sleeved design, making them ideal for outdoor events, sports uniforms, and casual corporate wear. Unlike standard shorts, the added sleeve length provides extra coverage and a more polished look, while keeping your team cool. Perfect for screen printing or embroidery, these garments offer a versatile canvas for your logo.
heroAltText: Custom short sleeve pants and shorts with embroidered logo for team uniforms
